This isn't just a pedal; it's a compact sonic weapon designed to electrify your tone and transport you to the heart of legendary fuzz. Feel the raw power of high-gain silicon transistors pushing your sound to the edge, delivering an intense, full-bodied fuzz with endless sustain. But the true magic lies in the integrated bias toggle. Flip it up for a classic, thick fuzz reminiscent of vintage masterpieces, or toggle it down to unlock a modern, gated fuzz that crackles with an exhilarating electric sizzle. This is the versatility you crave, all within a micro-sized powerhouse. Inspired by the iconic Tone Bender MK1.5, Renegade takes that legendary DNA and supercharges it with modern reliability and even more aggressive fuzz. With a single Master Volume knob, you'll command ample gain, and running it at 18 volts will unlock even more headroom and clarity. This is your invitation to explore a universe of fuzz tones, from vintage warmth to cutting-edge chaos. Each note will scream with character, adding a raw, captivating edge to your sound. And with mechanical true-bypass switching, your pure signal integrity is always preserved. Don't just play fuzz; ignite it.
